steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: I've heard that during the recent operation against the Sun Crow Apostle, you collaborated closely with the Eastian delegation.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Then this shouldn't pose a problem for you, I presume.
Early in the morning, a councilor visits the Bureau office, placing a stack of documents on your desk.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's been a week since the battle with the Apostle. Everything is back to normal, and the delegation has already returned to Eastia.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why bring up these old matters now?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: It's true the delegation has returned, but aren't you aware?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: One of them has turned back.
The councilor opens the folder, revealing the title page with the sharp font: <color=#fb9259>Du Ruo's Visa Application</color>.

options: Du Ruo is back in DisCity?
I'm not aware. When did this happen?

choices.text: Du Ruo is back in DisCity?
I'm not aware. When did this happen?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: You better not be playing dumb. After infiltrating DisCity's military operations, the Outland state is now sending an envoy here again under the guise of an academic visit... I shouldn't need to spell out the conflict of interest in this situation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...You suspect she has an ulterior motive?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: At the very least, we can't rule out the possibility that she is a spy. The discord between states can't be so easily mended, but we also can't break the superficial peace so soon after the Apostle operation. So, we can only ask you a favor.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: This is at Ambassador Du Ruo's own request. She's willing to undergo an assessment by the MBCC, and if she fails your evaluation, she agrees to be expelled.
The councilor leaves the documents behind and specifies the time to escort the ambassador to the Bureau for an entry assessment.
Before leaving, the councilor pats you on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: You have the authority to approve her application, but you should be well aware of the outcome DisCity desires.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Find a diplomatic excuse to send her back to Eastia. DisCity entrusts this task to you.

The interrogation room is kept at an apt temperature. Inside, the returning scholar is already seated and waiting. No handcuffs have been put on her, and the M-value detectors used against Sinners have been turned off.
At least on the surface, DisCity has shown considerable courtesy to this foreign dignitary.
Noticing someone entering, Du Ruo looks up, her eyes meeting yours.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: They say reunions are rarer than farewells. But here we are, reunited so soon.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I hope you're well, Chief. How have you been recovering from the Sun Crow's backfiring against the shackles?
She speaks placidly as if it's the most ordinary small talk.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I feel normal, and so do the shackles. Thank you for traveling all the way to inquire about my health.
You say emphatically, testing her attitude.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Is that so? Glad to hear it.
She doesn't lead the conversation to a new topic as you expected, simply nodding in relief. The interrogation room falls into awkward silence once more.
Du Ruo doesn't seem uncomfortable with the unusual silence. Her gaze lingers on your face before leisurely moving to the visa application in your hands. She smiles.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Is that a reunion gift you're holding?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I think you know better than I do what this is.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, you're throwing the question back at me. You've gotten more cunning in just a week, Chief. Looks like I'll have to come up with more sophisticated lies in the future.

options: Is the academic visit a lie too?

choices.text: Is the academic visit a lie too?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The crisis has been averted, why return to DisCity? Why didn't you contact me before coming back?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: From the moment the delegation first set foot in DisCity, all of you have been on the 9th Agency's watchlist. You knew this from the start, yet you still chose to take the risk alone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why did you specifically request me to conduct your entry assessment?
She doesn't answer and just leans forward slightly, observing you closely.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, are you anxious? Or are you angry?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Even in the face of the Sun Crow Apostle, you've never shown such emotions. What's different now?
She leans in a bit closer.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Are you upset because I didn't tell you before coming back? Or, are you... worried about me?

options: You're overthinking. I'm just doing my job.

choices.text: You're overthinking. I'm just doing my job.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You should know full well that DisCity will not let you in its border again.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: That's why I'm not seeking DisCity's opinion. I specifically volunteered for an evaluation by the MBCC's Chief, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...Didn't you want me to come back?
She seems eager for your response, but you can't tell if she's jesting or being sincere, so you steer the conversation back to the visa application.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This isn't about what I want personally. No one would have approved this flimsy application.

My account of DisCity's epic victory against the Sun Crow to the Eastian audience has been met with great enthusiasm. Interest in DisCity's culture is surging in my homeland.

Following the recent breakthrough in my Eastian mythology studies, I am seeking a chance for an academic visit to deepen my knowledge of DisCity's mythology and broaden the scope of my work.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Yes, I kept the handwriting elegant and the tone tactful. What could be the problem?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course, there's a problem...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's only been a few days since the delegation left DisCity. Even the fastest transport couldn't have taken you through WhiteSands back to Eastia with your Sun Crow myth and then doubled back to DisCity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Having fought alongside you for so long, I can tell you're the biggest non-believer among the delegation of these so-called myths. You even actively disproved and debunked the legends many times.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What you want to collect isn't just DisCity's myths.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: DisCity was only established after Nightfall. As an emerging immigrant state, it doesn't have a rich history or culture like Eastia.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Here, you can only study the declining mine factories, new urban technologies, and...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Black Rings, Mania, Hypercubes.
These are the core of DisCity's secrets, and this is the conclusion you least want to reach. At the mention of these terms, the atmosphere in the interrogation room drops to freezing point.
She has listened to your scrutiny of her application. When you voice your suspicions about espionage, she finally opens her eyes.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I remember you liked listening to my stories. Would you like to hear one now, for old times' sake?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You haven't responded to my question yet.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The answer is in the story.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A myth?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: A true story.
She takes out an Eastian-style incense burner.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The story is a bit long. Do you mind if I light some incense? It helps clear my thoughts.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Don't worry, it's just ordinary incense. I promise not to mix in anything weird.
Amid the rising plumes of smoke, she begins.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Since the beginning of my memory, my parents had already sent me to the academy.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The Eastian continent has a long-standing civilization that even Nightfall never interrupted. In our education system, the teachers enlighten us by retelling all kinds of mythological stories. The myth of the Sun Crow myth is one of them.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But after hearing the myth of the Sun Crow from my teacher for the first time, I was skeptical. Why would people worship something that brought nothing but disasters to humanity?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The teacher didn't answer my question. He simply said, "Just remember what's written in the textbook."
Du Ruo chuckles softly, shaking her head a little wryly.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It'll probably surprise you. I wasn't exactly a model student in my childhood. The more the teacher said that, the more I refused to accept it.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I dismissed the myth as superstition and tried to prove that the Sun Crow was not a god, but just a Wraith Beast. Then, starting with a series of skeptical viewpoints, I began my research as a mythologist.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Over the years of research, I read some books and also made some friends.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Some friends, like me, did not believe in myths, but they sacrificed their lives to protect those ignorant beliefs.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Some friends would choose the greater good over personal beliefs in a heartbeat, and dedicate decades of anonymous effort to it.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: And some friends... You've already met them.

options: The seer inside the Sun Crow?

choices.text: The seer inside the Sun Crow?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Yes, it was Xu and the others who saved Sunset Town from the ten-sun calamity. They showed me that even after reading all these books, what I was seeking was just the shallowest part of the myths.
She speaks with rare candor.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It turned out that miracles really did exist. They were created by my late friends... by people.
You've never seen Du Ruo get so serious before. She's fighting to suppress her emotions, but you can still easily sense the fluctuations of Mania in the air.
This was clearly not an easy past for her. She takes some time to adjust her breathing.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You call me a non-believer, and that's true. I only believe in the truth built by humans with their blood and sweat.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But you're wrong about DisCity not having its own myths.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: For those who have witnessed devastation, the construction of such a prosperous city under the disasters is a myth in itself.
The room quiets down, and the incense in the burner just happens to burn out. But Du Ruo's new interpretation of mythology still lingers in the interrogation room like the scent of the smoke.
Perhaps it's only at this moment that you truly understand her identity as a mythologist.

options: Did you really come for the DisCity myth?

choices.text: Did you really come for the DisCity myth?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: If you don't believe me, why not join me on my academic visit?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It just so happens I need a guide to show me around DisCity and to help me understand the local customs. How do the people here view the disasters they've overcome and their current lives? And how do they live with the potential threat of Mania?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are these also part of the myth?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Of course. Just like the idea that mere mortals can shoot down the sun with their faith, to Eastia which lacks the protection of Hypercubes, these seemingly mundane daily experiences are as dreamy as a legend or a hope...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Will you join me in writing this DisCity myth? I'm sure you're a highly anticipated character in this story.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Do your fellow townspeople like this sort of thing?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sure. I, for one, do. Give me a chance to write you into this story. Will you indulge me just for once?
She resumes her usual teasing demeanor, tapping lightly on the visa approval with her index finger.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: You have the authority to approve her application, but you should be well aware of the outcome DisCity desires.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Find a diplomatic excuse to send her back to Eastia. DisCity entrusts this task to you.
Despite your so-called right of approval, in reality, you can only choose between an unconditional expulsion and the burden of full responsibility.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The aim of this academic visit can only be a cultural exchange, as you've clarified. Anything related to the city's secrets is off-limits, and you must stay away from all the sensitive areas listed in the application...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: These are the only rights the MBCC can secure for you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: So, I've passed your entry assessment?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Although you're a habitual liar, I'm still willing to bet on your passion for mythology. Besides, I'll accompany you throughout the academic visit to keep an eye on you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Aren't you afraid of upsetting those big shots?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You don't need to worry about that. The MBCC will draft a special entry agreement for you. Just follow the rules and focus on writing your myth.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Hmm, bossy. You know, you're pretty charismatic, even as someone from DisCity. Don't forget you still owe me an answer, Chief. Can you tell me now?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Chief, did you... want me to come back?
She lowers her voice, staring at you with a foxy grin.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then you also owe me an answer. You couldn't have doubled back from Eastia to DisCity in just a few days. Why lie in the visa application?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I see...
She hesitates for a moment. You seem to catch a fleeting hint of disappointment on her face.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Then let's consider us even on this matter.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: See you on the streets of DisCity, fellow traveler.
